source_text:
Which catecholamine is NOT metabolized by COMT?
A. Adrenaline 
B. Noradrenaline 
C. Dopamine 
D. Isoprenaline 
NONE

ai_result.review_reason: All four listed catecholamines—adrenaline, noradrenaline, dopamine, and isoprenaline—contain a catechol group and are metabolized by catechol-O-methyltransferase (COMT). Therefore, none is a uniquely correct answer, and the item cannot function as a single-best-answer MCQ without revision.
ai_result.question: Which catecholamine is NOT metabolized by catechol-O-methyltransferase (COMT)?

explanations.A: Adrenaline is metabolized by COMT to metanephrine, as well as by other metabolic pathways.
explanations.B: Noradrenaline is metabolized by COMT to normetanephrine, as well as by other metabolic pathways.
explanations.C: Dopamine is metabolized by COMT to 3-methoxytyramine, as well as by other metabolic pathways.
explanations.D: Isoprenaline is also metabolized by COMT; therefore, it is not a uniquely correct answer.
